entries.81a81786323cbae7: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the company, its 37 subsidiaries and two affiliates (as of March 31, 2026) are mainly engaged in businesses related to two segments: the Time Information Systems Business and the Environmental Systems Business. Its management policy sets out, as its management philosophy, the creation of new value in the fields of "people and time" and "people and air." Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥176,467 million (up 0.6% year on year). The Time Information Systems Business accounted for ¥136,925 million and the Environmental Systems Business for ¥39,541 million. Overseas revenue was ¥84,748 million, accounting for 48.0% of consolidated revenue.

The securities report states that in Japan, Amano's standalone large systems rose ¥1,180 million (up 15.0%) and maintenance and supplies also rose, while general-purpose units fell ¥431 million (down 6.0%), and overseas sales decreased in both North America and Asia.
entries.9664ca79b2505415: This reportable segment makes and sells dust collectors and dust collection equipment that clean the air in factories and other sites, and cleaning equipment that cleans floors and other surfaces. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥39,541 million (down 0.1% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥4,918 million. The company manufactures the products and sells them in Japan, and also exports them to some overseas regions. Amano Musashi Denki Co., Ltd. manufactures cleaning equipment; Amano Pioneer Eclipse Corp. (United States) manufactures cleaning equipment, floor maintenance chemical products and dust collectors; Amano Time & Air Thailand Co.,Ltd. manufactures dust collectors and dust collection equipment; and Kankyo Eisei Kenkyujo Co., Ltd. carries out work environment measurement and other services.
